about: D19c query-language centroids, keyed by the text model's file name (Embedder.textFingerprint). A model with no entry here (a fine-tuned bundle) keeps the D19 word-list gate until its own centroids are built.

stock-eg2-text.provenance: scripts/bench/ww_gate3.py (arm C, margin 0): renormalised per-language mean of 21,698 LLM-generated training queries embedded with the stock 740m teacher (QP query prompt)
stock-eg2-text.why one set serves three bundles: the stock 740m, 440m and 270m bundles give identical text vectors (probe cosine 1.0, engine_probes.json)
stock-eg2-text.file: centroids_fp16.bin is 16 x 768 little-endian fp16 unit vectors in the order of langs.json
